notes:
A big one: build your own collections, grab subtitles without leaving the player,
fix up any title's details and artwork, and get around faster.

- **Build your own collections.** Group videos from anywhere into one series — a
  "Warhammer 40,000" made of fan films, a season someone uploaded in pieces,
  whatever you like. Add a whole show, or right-click a single episode to add
  just that one. Everything you add still shows in its original place too, so
  nothing disappears; a small badge marks a collection on its cover. Rename,
  reorder, and remove from **Manage collection**.

- **Subtitles, straight from the player.** A new search button finds and
  downloads subtitles for whatever you're watching and turns them on instantly —
  pick a language, pick a result, done. Subtitles that already came with a
  download now show up automatically too, and anything you fetch is saved on the
  server so everyone gets it next time.

- **Edit a title's info and artwork.** Open a movie or show and hit **Edit info**
  to change the title, year, description, which section it lives in (TV Show /
  Anime / Movie), and the poster or backdrop — paste an image link or upload your
  own. Right-click an episode to fix its name or thumbnail. You can edit anything
  you added; admins can edit everything. **Reset to automatic** puts it back.

- **Mouse back and forward.** The side buttons on your mouse now navigate back and
  forward through the app, and inside the player Back steps out of what you're
  watching.

- **Everyone sees the suggestions and bugs.** The suggestions page now shows all
  of the family's messages, not just your own — so you can see what's already
  been asked before sending it again.

- **Libraries open on what's new.** Each library now sorts by most-recently-added
  by default (there's a **Latest** option in the sort menu alongside A–Z, Year and
  Rating). And a finished download in **Add Media** now has a **Watch** button
  that jumps straight to it.

---
Windows updates itself on the next launch. Linux updates through your system updater if you installed 2.6.8 or newer; if you are on an older version, download the `.deb` below and install it once more.
